question: Where do repeated operational paired-receptor keys occur among nominal source CD8 codes in nine mice, and does source representation or chain inclusion change that nomination?
decision: Nominate a source-code context for later label qualification or retain convention-sensitive/unsupported findings; do not infer independent RNA states, redistribution or age effects.
strongest_rival: Source annotation may contain receptor-informed decisions; unequal processed-table representation and chain observation can resemble a biological concentration difference. Codes and eligible populations are not exchangeable.
discriminator: Exact per-mouse nominal-code and lineage pair-collision concentration, all support/representation alongside, strict-pair primary and complete-chain-set sensitivity, preserving unsupported rows and no age pooling.
exposure_record: Earlier A27 source/state findings and source notebook/comments exposed. Current preparation inspected sample/label/chain eligibility coverage only, not cross-cell operational clone assignments, frequencies or concentration. Still exploratory descriptive, not an unexposed confirmatory claim.
biological_unit: Nine exact source mice, with processed RNA/TCR cells and cell pairs nested within each animal; no additional animals from assays or cells.
nesting_and_overlap: Source GEX/TCR/hashtag records share mice/cells. Source-code and ALL_CD8 rows reuse cells; keys can span codes within a mouse. Strict and set conventions overlap and differ in eligibility. No independent replication.
population_and_selection: GSE347791 IGT29 source-labelled CD8 GEX cells from mouse0088-0096; all20 exact nominal source codes; receptor-only and unannotated GEX cells remain outside source-CD8 denominators with missingness retained.
contrast: Within each mouse, lineage and all20 nominal source codes under strict single observed productive pair and complete productive-chain-set sensitivity; source age/sex displayed without pooling or inferred aging effect.
endpoint: Observed same-operational-key unordered eligible-cell pairs / all unordered distinct eligible-cell pairs; N<2 NA. Exact NT and canonical full V/J call sets within mouse.
methods: Retain fixed mice/codes, derive source-faithful chain eligibility and verify every prior coverage flag. Generate378 concentration rows,189 support rows, nine source disposition rows, cell/key assignments and clone counts. Validate strict-subset partition parity and cross-code pooling. Shared[0,1] fixed-order plots label N/NA and explicit representation denominators.
missingness_and_exclusions: No imputed chains, highest-read selection, age pooling or unlabelled CD8 assignment. Preserve unproductive, missing, ambiguous, dual and nonstandard source flags. Both conventions exclude incomplete productive/nonstandard slots; zero code denominator and N<2 are NA, not observed zero.
multiplicity: No population intervals, pair-independence assumption, significance tests, effect thresholds, ranking, state regrouping or age effect. All codes/conventions retained.
precision_basis: N>=2 is mathematical computability only; report N, pair count and single-collision resolution, source representation and selection. Sparse zero/flat values are not equivalence. No invented power or precision threshold.
interpretation_limit: Nominal source codes; independent RNA-state construction unestablished. Source-aware keys are operational labels, not proven antigen-specific lineages. Different conventions combine inclusion/matching/chain-observation effects. No biological redistribution, function, population aging or causal inference; no exact replication of prior depth-five diversity metric.
stop_rule: Stop for input/hash/roster/label/chain coverage/partition failure and refuse output overwrite; preserve source versions and unfavorable results. Do not relax eligibility or seek a favorable subset.
amendment_reason: New processed-source nominal-code description after the earlier atlas state contrast lacked support; different endpoint and source, with no replacement of prior results.
